remarks: Stunning 4 bedroom, 2.0 bath home in Broad River!! - Light & bright kitchen with white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, brand new Thor professional grade 36" gas rangetop, granite counters, and new subway tile backsplash! - Kitchen features counter seating and opens to dining area - Living room features built-ins, and a gas fireplace - 2 bedrooms on the main level + a brand new bathroom: new vanity, lighting, tile floor, tub, and subway tile shower with custom niche! - 2nd floor features 2 more bedrooms and another brand new full bathroom! - Primary bedroom offers good closet space + French doors out to private 2nd floor balcony! - Laundry room on 2nd floor - Finished lower level with recessed lighting offers lots of additional options for family room, home gym, etc. - Hardwood floors throughout - 1 car attached garage with epoxy floor coating - Sliding door from dining room leads out to large & private back deck with custom metal railing system - Stairs from deck down to private yard space - Amazingly convenient location... walk to a few restaurants in Broad River, or just minutes by car to the Merritt, I-95, SoNo, and all Norwalk has to offer! - Cat or small dog considered on case by case basis
